verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs say users can build funnels and segment users to answer "why" (amplitude-docs-5, amplitude-docs-18), and can jump from a funnel to the exact session to see what happened (amplitude-docs-31). Plain-language AI and the MCP server promise answers with "no SQL… or waiting on the data team" (amplitude-docs-10, amplitude-docs-34), and a community user reports getting non-analysts across the whole team using it (amplitude-comm-1). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on step-by-step drop-off and conversion-rate views, and hands-on corroboration that a founder can find the losing activation step alone (one report also says instrumentation is hard and data often wrong, amplitude-comm-3).
